title: VDI 3405 Blatt 3:2015-12 Additive manufacturing processes, rapid manufacturing - Design rules for part production using laser sintering and laser beam melting
publisher: Verein Deutscher Ingenieure; distributed by DIN Media
notes: Cited by designation only. The guideline was not bought and not read; nothing is taken from its content. The distributor page read on 2026-11-12 marks it withdrawn, 32 pages, and names DIN EN ISO/ASTM 52911-1:2020-05 and 52911-2:2020-06 as the documents to use instead. Recorded so that a later reader does not cite the withdrawn guideline as current.
